description.narrative: The IDF's development objective is building capacity at the Department of Public Administration (DPA) and the Cabinet Officecomma under the Prime Minister's Office to contribute to increasing public service performance and efficiency in Grenada. Capacity will be built through training government teams to: (i) Conduct human resource staffing and expenditure reviews in five pilot ministries to determine the right staffing of public sector agencies based on services delivered to citizens and preparing an action plan to implement these recommendations; and (ii) Enhance policy coordination mechanisms across ministries by conducting process reengineering exercises. Building capacity at the Department of Public Administration (DPA) and the Cabinet's Officecomma both under Grenada's Office o f the Prime Ministercomma to contribute to enhancing quality of public expenditures in Grenadacomma with a special focus on improving the management of personnel expenditures. Capacity will be built in these two institutions by: (i) the implementationcomma by the DPA with external supportcomma of human resource staffing and expenditure reviews in five pilot ministries with the objective of determining the right staffing of these public sector agencies based on services delivered to citizens and building their capacity to continue with the other agencies; and (ii) Strengthening the Cabinet's office ability to monitor and evaluate programs with the purpose of informing the budget planning process and enhancing quality of public expenditures.
